title: VotifierNext
description: A fresh take on Votifier, for NeoForge
body:
Votifier-Next is a refreshed take on the popular Votifier mod, coded from the ground up to match the modern Minecraft game.

With Votifier you can give your players rewards when they vote on a server list website.

The mod will generate example reward files if the `config/votifier_next/rewards` directory does not exist.
You can see examples of how to format these files [here](https://github.com/Up-Mods/VotifierNext/tree/main/src/main/resources/data/votifier_next/example_rewards).

Wiki for advanced usage such as database configuration coming soon!
